Overview

Bacolod is a city in Negros Occidental with a population of 561,000. The City of Smiles, known for its MassKara Festival, sugar industry heritage, and friendly local culture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
